currentParagraphText: “He held on longer than I thought he would,” Artemis said from right behind Jake. “Last time I checked in on him, he was far more of a glass cannon who could do impressive damage but often found himself pressured and forced to use an expensive escape skill of his to survive. His defenses have definitely improved.”
